hints: Wrap `csv_text` in `io.StringIO` and parse rows with `csv.DictReader` so quoted fields like `"$1,250.50"` are split accurately.
Check validity (non-empty `tx_id`/`region`, `status != "cancelled"`, valid float `amount > 0`) BEFORE checking `seen_ids` so invalid rows increment `dropped_count` first.
